# dim_itinerary_blocks

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_itinerary_blocks` · dbt area: `portal`

Dimension table for itinerary blocks, which make up the content of their parent itinerary. Each row represents a single block (page, text, flight, etc.). Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `itinerary_block_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each Itinerary block. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `archived_at` | Timestamp of when the block was archived. Note when an Itinerary is archived, its blocks aren't automatically archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `block_type` | The type of block component (page, title, header, booking, etc). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | Timestamp of when the block was created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | True/False flag indicating whether this block has been archived. Note when an Itinerary is archived, its blocks aren't automatically archived >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `itinerary_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to the block's parent Itinerary. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `latest_itinerary_version_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to the block's latest Itinerary version. A new version_id is generated each time an itinerary is republished. >> SOURCE - Portal >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp of when the block was last updated by the Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `version_created_at` | Timestamp of when the Itinerary version was created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
